meta.title: IL Adaptive Item Bank
meta.notes: Author-estimated a,b (not online IRT calibration). Socratic feedback never dumps answer letter first on wrong picks. Expand toward 150 keeping concept coverage ≥5/topic.

items.stem: Which command lists all files including hidden ones in the current directory?

feedback.A: -a shows entries starting with '.' — hidden files.
feedback.B: -l is long format; it does not imply hidden files.
feedback.C: That changes directory to home; it does not list.
feedback.D: pwd prints the working directory path.

items.stem: An absolute path always starts with…

feedback.A: On Unix, absolute paths begin at the filesystem root '/'.
feedback.B: ./ is relative to the current directory.
feedback.C: ~ expands to home, but absolute paths are not limited to home.
feedback.D: $PATH is an environment variable for executables.

items.stem: What does the shell pipe | do?

choices.text: Sends stdout of left command to stdin of right
Runs both commands on separate hosts

items.stem: Mode 755 on a file typically means…

feedback.B: Write for others would need a '2' or '6/7' in that digit.
feedback.D: Setuid is a special bit, not 755.

feedback.B: chmod changes mode bits, not owner.
feedback.C: chgrp changes group; chown handles user too.

items.stem: A sticky bit on /tmp mainly prevents…

choices.text: Users deleting others' files in the directory

feedback.A: Sticky on a dir: only owner (or root) may unlink.

items.stem: You want a snapshot of running processes. First tool?

feedback.A: Process table tools are the starting point.
feedback.B: That flushes firewall rules — dangerous and unrelated.

items.stem: systemctl status nginx shows a unit is failed. Next useful step?

choices.text: Disable SELinux permanently as first step

feedback.A: Unit logs usually explain the failure.
feedback.D: Loses transient signal; read logs first.

items.stem: On modern systemd hosts, centralized logs are often in…

feedback.C: Git is VCS, not runtime logs.

items.stem: IP addresses are primarily a ___ concern; TCP ports are ___ .

feedback.A: Network vs transport in the common model.
feedback.C: MAC is L2; HTTP is L7.
feedback.D: Physical layer is bits on wire.

items.stem: Usable hosts in a classic /24 (RFC 950 style)?

feedback.A: Nested prefixes overlap; longest-match wins in routing.
feedback.B: Length alone does not guarantee disjointness.

feedback.C: Certs are not DNS A records.

choices.text: The queried name does not exist in DNS

feedback.D: Network path, not DNS response code.

items.stem: SNI in TLS helps the server…

choices.text: Choose the right certificate for a hostname
Bad gateway — upstream failure via a proxy
Only a diff with no tree

feedback.B: Implementation may pack deltas; model is snapshots.

items.stem: A branch in Git is best described as…

choices.text: A movable pointer to a commit
A full copy of all blobs always

items.stem: Detached HEAD — safest way to keep new work?

feedback.A: Name the commit with a branch.

choices.text: Branch pointer moves forward with no merge commit
Git always invents a merge commit

items.stem: Interactive rebase is usually wrong when…

choices.text: Rewriting commits already on shared main
Editing a message on your branch
Git commits of the app only

items.stem: Relying on :latest in production is risky because…

choices.text: The tag can move to a different digest over time
Always be systemd on the host
Declare multi-container apps for local/dev stacks
Replace Kubernetes in all prod clusters
The smallest deployable unit; one or more containers sharing net/ns
Causes kubelet to restart the container
Pod removed from Service endpoints until ready

feedback.A: Traffic stops; container may keep running.

items.stem: Terraform configuration is primarily written in…

feedback.D: May wrap TF, not the language.

choices.text: Mapping of resources to real-world IDs

feedback.A: State is the source of truth for managed objects.

choices.text: Editing prod DBs by hand first
Stored as encrypted Actions secrets, never in the repo
Committed as plaintext in workflow YAML

items.stem: on: push in a workflow means…

choices.text: The workflow triggers when commits are pushed
Desired state in Git reconciled to the cluster
SSH snowflake edits with no record
Grant only the permissions needed for the task

items.stem: A security group / firewall rule set typically filters…

choices.text: Allowed ingress/egress by port, protocol, source/dest
Durable blobs addressed by key, not a POSIX disk
A quantitative measure of service level (e.g. success rate)
Actionable, tied to user impact, not raw noise
A secrets manager / sealed store — not git

items.stem: Scanning container images in CI helps catch…
Which directory usually holds user home folders on Linux?
Sending SIGTERM to a process typically…
Longest prefix match means routers prefer…

choices.text: Working tree / staging vs HEAD differences

items.stem: Rolling update on a Deployment aims to…

choices.text: Replace Pods gradually to keep availability
Block merge/deploy until fixed or explicitly overridden
Page every engineer for flake noise only

items.stem: Root / highly privileged accounts should be…

choices.text: Investigate recent deploys, deps, and saturation

items.stem: A Terraform provider is responsible for…

choices.text: Talking to an API (cloud/SaaS) to CRUD resources
